title: Per-question try-harder / try-easier tier-shift
summary: Two buttons in the companion app per question (after G1's verifier returns 'incorrect' or 'correct'): 'Try easier' biases the next question to Foundation tier; 'Try harder' biases to Higher. Reuses Phase F's tier filter on curriculumBank.lookupBySpecRef and G2's anotherOneLikeThis pipeline.

in: client/src/lib/tierShift.ts (new, ~100 LoC) — wraps anotherOneLikeThis (G2) with a tier-shifted bias
client/src/components/TierShiftButtons.tsx (new, ~80 LoC) — two buttons on the wrong-answer / correct-answer card in the companion
Targeted vitest: tier-shift bias respected; bank-miss falls back to LLM with pinned tier
out: Auto-shift based on streak (e.g. 3 correct → auto-try-harder) — deferred

acceptance_criteria: 'Try easier' button shows only when current question's tier ≥ Foundation; returns a Foundation-or-below variant on the same specRef.
'Try harder' button shows only when current question's tier ≤ Higher; returns a Higher-or-above variant.
Both buttons use G2's anotherOneLikeThis with a tier-shift parameter — no new prompt path.
